culture._comment: Near / far from the ancestors (docs/plan_civilization_steps.md 'What belief does, through seams that exist'; .claude/rules/core_sim/belief.md 'The culture morale term'). Each band remembers one belief tile, its anchor. With b = the anchor's belief, s = b / (b + belief_half_saturation) and r the band's kin-relay strength, the morale term is s x (r x near_bonus - (1 - r) x away_drag): r = 1 while the band stands within its own walking reach of the anchor (migration.base_reach, lengthened by roads exactly as migration's reach is), giving +near_bonus x s; r = relay_per_hop^n when n bands of its own people tie it in, giving the blend; r = 0 when nothing reaches it, giving -away_drag x s; 0 with no anchor. The drag does not grow with distance. PLAYTEST DIALs.
culture._comment_near_bonus: Morale per turn gained at full strength (r = 1, standing within the band's own reach) of a saturated anchor; scaled by r when kin tie the band in. PLAYTEST DIAL.
culture._comment_away_drag: Morale per turn lost when nothing ties the band to a saturated anchor (r = 0); scaled by 1 - r when kin tie it in. PLAYTEST DIAL.
culture._comment_belief_half_saturation: Belief at which the anchor weighs one half. Belief is in dead-equivalents, so 10 = ten people's worth of ancestors: a single death barely registers and a great cemetery caps the term. Must be > 0. PLAYTEST DIAL.
culture._comment_min_anchor_belief: The least belief a place must hold before a band adopts it as its anchor - one whole death's worth at 1.0 (belief is in dead-equivalents). Belief accrues FRACTIONAL deaths every turn, so without this gate every band would anchor to its start tile on turn one. Gates adoption only; accrual is unchanged, so a tile can still read under one dead. Must be finite and >= 0. PLAYTEST DIAL.
culture._comment_relay_per_hop: How much of the ancestors' reach each hop of KIN relays. A band of the same people within walking reach of a band that is near is itself near at this strength, and each further hop multiplies by it again (no hop cap - it dies out). The term blends near and far by that strength r: s x (r x near_bonus - (1 - r) x away_drag), so r = 1 (direct) and r = 0 (unreached) are the two plain values. Same people and resident bands only; relaying never adopts a place. Must be finite and in [0, 1]; 0 turns relaying off. PLAYTEST DIAL.

crowding._comment: Too many of one people on one tile (docs/plan_civilization_steps.md 'Cohesion is a property of a group'; .claude/rules/core_sim/belief.md 'The crowding morale term'). The unit is the co-located group: every RESIDENT band of one people standing on the same tile (a lone band is a group of one; detached parties are not members). With b = the belief on the tile the group stands on and s = b / (b + belief_half_saturation), the group's cohesion ceiling is base_ceiling + belief_lift x s, and every member band reads -drag x max(0, group - ceiling) / ceiling: 0 at or under the ceiling. No hard cap; the leavers are carried by discontent migration because the term lowers morale. All four are OPENING VALUES and PLAYTEST DIALs.
crowding._comment_base_ceiling: The cohesion ceiling with no belief underfoot, in people (Dunbar's number). Must be finite and > 0. OPENING VALUE, PLAYTEST DIAL.
crowding._comment_belief_lift: People a saturated tile adds to the ceiling (s -> 1). Must be finite and >= 0; 0 means belief lifts nothing. OPENING VALUE, PLAYTEST DIAL.
crowding._comment_belief_half_saturation: Belief (dead-equivalents) at which the lift is half. Crowding's own lever, separate from culture.belief_half_saturation. Must be finite and > 0. OPENING VALUE, PLAYTEST DIAL.
crowding._comment_drag: Morale per turn lost per 100% over the ceiling. At the shipped settling +0.01 a group 10% over nets -0.01 a turn, so the leak starts just past the ceiling. Must be finite and >= 0. OPENING VALUE, PLAYTEST DIAL.
